name: web-sidebar-with-announcement-card-and-user-account-footer
title: Empty sidebar with a bordered 'Simple Announcement' card with a blue dot at the bottom, and a user row with icon, initials, email and up-down chevrons
whatItIs: A white screen split by a vertical line; the left sidebar is empty at the top and holds at the bottom a rounded bordered card 'Simple Announcement' with a grey line and a blue notification dot at its corner, then a user row with a person icon, 'KL', 'kl@example.com' and an up-down chevron.
whatItMeans: Quiet and useful; announcements and account controls sit low where thumbs and eyes expect them.
techniques: Anchor announcement and user rows at the bottom.
Mark new content with a blue dot.

vocabulary.definition: The bottom section of a sidebar with account controls.
A small card notifying about news.
A small coloured dot marking something new.
A row with up-down chevrons to change account.
